items.en: Mist building, maybe. Headlights wouldn't hurt.
items.reason: The June 2026 Sesotho reviewer replaced "Tlhabisa mabone" (switch the lights on) with "tlosa mabone" (take the lights off): the reviewer's own reference reverses the advice. It is the origin of the live st-0870 reversal.
